scoring_justification: Recompute mean log10(TOF) and apparent activation energy from raw MKM results at a specified temperature, comparing to paper-reported distribution parameters (T1). GA covariance matrix scored structurally (T3).

outputs.description: GA group covariance matrix (enthalpy and entropy) from OLS fit; the checker recomputes the matrix from the same training set and compares element-wise within tolerance.

Raw MKM simulation results for 5000 perturbations × temperature grid. The checker recomputes QoI statistics (mean log10(TOF), mean apparent activation energy, mean reaction orders) from these raw data and compares to hidden paper-derived gold values.
Aggregated statistics derived from the raw MKM results; the checker compares the reported means with its own recomputed values to verify consistency.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are produced in order. The primary scoring weight is on the raw MKM results (ethane_odh_perturbed_results.csv), from which the checker independently recomputes the headline QoI distributions. The aggregated stats file provides a cross-check.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for TOF, E_app, and reaction orders
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Figure 7b and text for Gaussian mixture parameters of log10(TOF) distribution (μ1=-0.28, μ2=-1.69, ω1=0.75) and Figure 8b for apparent activation energy components (28 and 42 kcal/mol, weights ~0.7/0.3). Reaction orders from text: ethane ~1, oxygen ~0.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Overall mean log10(TOF) = 0.75*(-0.28) + 0.25*(-1.69) = -0.6325. Overall mean E_app = 0.7*28 + 0.3*42 = 32.2 kcal/mol. Tolerances set to absorb implementation variation while rejecting wrong pipelines.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Gold values are derived from the paper's own reported distribution statistics, not invented.
